description: Nora is hosting a casual 50th-anniversary gathering for her parents at a community hall and must make the final call about the program, recording, room setup, and accessibility arrangements with input from her brother Eli, cousin Samira, and aunt June.

shared_context.S1: Nora's parents are celebrating their 50th wedding anniversary with a family gathering at the Maple Street Community Hall.
shared_context.S2: The hall is reserved from 18:00 to 21:00 on 2026-07-18.
shared_context.S3: Nora is finalizing the event program, recording plan, room setup, and seating arrangements.
shared_context.S4: The hall has a main entrance on the south side and a long west wall with electrical outlets.
shared_context.S5: Before Nora locks the plan, the family's usual round of checking with everyone gives each person a chance to raise anything that should shape the gathering.

PF1.text: Eli spoke with the anniversary couple last weekend, and they requested no speeches or surprise tributes; they want one quiet 20-minute conversation recorded as audio only, with no video or livestream. They have not told Nora directly.

PF2.text: Samira confirmed with the hall coordinator that decorations must stay along the west wall because the south entrance route must remain open, and open flames are not allowed anywhere in the hall. This information has not reached the group yet.

PF3.text: June now uses a walker and needs a continuously clear aisle at least 36 inches wide, plus a regular chair positioned close to the south entrance. She has not brought this up to Nora yet.

acceptance_conditions: The program must contain no speeches or surprise tributes.
The only recording must be a 20-minute audio conversation, with no video or livestream.
Decorations must be placed along the west wall.
The lighting plan must use battery-operated LED lights with no open flames.
The seating plan must preserve a continuously clear 36-inch aisle and place a regular chair close to the south entrance.
A commitment to keep the south entrance route clear must be recorded.

decisive_facts.why: The couple's specific request changes the program from ordinary anniversary speeches to a quiet 20-minute conversation and changes recording from a possible video or livestream to audio only.
The hall coordinator's exact rules change decoration placement to the west wall, prohibit open flames in favor of battery LEDs, and require a commitment to keep the south entrance route clear.
June's walker requirement changes the seating plan to a continuously clear aisle of at least 36 inches with a regular chair close to the south entrance.
